verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a Prompt Playground for experimenting with prompts, models and invocation parameters, comparing configurations side by side, and iterating against real production examples and datasets, plus Span Replay of real LLM calls. missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompt template variables and their substitution in the playground, independent or hands-on corroboration of playground use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: Prompt Playground - Play with prompts, models, invocation parameters and track your progress via tracing and experiments
Comparing prompt configurations and responses in the Phoenix playground

Phoenix helps you iterate on prompts using real examples from your application. You can version prompts, test prompt variants across datasets, and replay calls to see how changes affect outputs before rolling them out.
experiment with variations across different models and inputs
